negative branch (eigenvalue exp(+i Omega), phase -Omega) has projector Pi_-(p) = (1 - K)/2. It is defined at every p
iff the period has no point with P = +-1 (gaps at 0 and at pi). Checks (MEASURED, float64):

Local space per cell: record (arrow block chi = X_r) x spin (frame basis) x weak index s (2). Under the chiral reading the
block chi = +1 holds the left-handed doublet (s transforms under SU(2)), the block chi = -1 two right-handed singlets
(s is a species label, no link). Static SU(2) links G_{x,i} on the left-handed block. MEASURED (float64, dense, 3x3x2
torus, 144 dimensions).

  S_i(G)    = block +1: T_i(G) P^+ + T_i(G)^-1 P^-  (alpha_i = sigma_i there);  block -1: the bare routing sub-step
  (a) record-flip factorization Q' = S_i(G) R (R = record reflection, the CF-1 form): unitary, but Q'^2 != 1
  (b) doublet-flip factorization S_i(G) = Q_i(G) Sigma_i, Sigma_i = sigma_(i+1) on the spin: Q_i(G) built explicitly as

      v = (|x, chi=-1, up_i, xi> - c |x+e_i, chi=-1, down_i, xi>)/sqrt2 (c = <down_i|sigma_(i+1)|up_i>), compared with
      S_i(G) Sigma_i; involution, block preserving, gauge covariant
  (c) gauge covariance of S_i(G), Q_i(G), Sigma_i under random g_x in SU(2) on the left-handed block
  (d) the mass step exp(-i theta beta) and the Wilson term of member B break it; dressed by a classical Higgs frame

oriented_link.note:
T3 extra item: the routing tick with the audit's oriented quantum link in place of the bare link signs.

Link carrier: the audit's 119-state link (RER model/coherent_defect_wave/chiral_joint/oriented_links, read only)
restricted to the one-dimensional native block (index 9): states blank 0, (+), (-); backward transport (quantum from
x + e_i to x) U = |+><0| + |0><-|, forward transport U^dagger; orientation reversal J: (+) <-> (-). (For d = 1 the
block normalisation 1/sqrt(d) is 1.) One quantum: coin = record x spin (frame basis), index 2 r + s.

Seam involution with a quantum link (one-quantum sector): for the routing pair (A, B) of a link, h = |A><B| x V +
|B><A| x V^dagger with V the transport, h^2 = P a projection (V a partial isometry), and G = (1 - P) + h is a unitary
involution: the swap with transport where the move is allowed, the identity where the link is saturated. With a
classical unit link (P = 1) it is the CF-1 seam involution. S_i = G_i R as in CF-1.
